title: Juicy Dutch Grape Leaves Wrap
description: A bitter and juicy Dutch dish featuring grape leaves, with a crunchy pickle and nut-free-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Wash the grape leaves and remove stems.
Combine raisin vinegar, chopped parsley, juniper berries, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Add the pickled red onion to the bowl and mix well.
Lay a grape leaf flat on a work surface and place a small amount of the onion mixture in the center.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package.
Repeat with the remaining grape leaves and filling.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the grape leaf rolls seam-side down and cook for 5 minutes on each side.
Serve the grape leaf wraps hot with a drizzle of balsamic glaze.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
